scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/gen-deps.mjs && node scripts/gen-update-meta.mjs
scripts.dist: node scripts/gen-update-meta.mjs && electron-vite build && node scripts/check-kernel.mjs && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/gen-update-meta.mjs && electron-vite build && node scripts/check-kernel.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: node scripts/gen-update-meta.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-vite build && node scripts/check-kernel.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/gen-update-meta.mjs && electron-vite build && node scripts/check-kernel.mjs && electron-builder --linux --publish never
